'''Vera Beroya''' was a fierce [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] warrior who rose to prominence during the era of the Galactic Empire. As the chieftain of [[Clan Awaud/Legends|Clan Awaud]], she exemplified the resilience and martial prowess characteristic of Mandalorian leaders.

==Biography==
===Background and Rise to Leadership===
Vera was the adopted daughter of Nam Beroya, a staunch traditionalist and the previous chieftain of Clan Awaud. Nam distanced the clan from the internal conflicts on Mandalore, particularly the strife between Duchess Satine's pacifist New Mandalorians and Pre Vizsla's militant Death Watch. Seeking a new beginning, he relocated the clan to Vlemoth Port, establishing a sanctuary for warriors disillusioned with Mandalore's political turmoil. 

During a mission to protect allied Talz tribes from Zygerrian slavers, Nam was captured and presumed dead. Unbeknownst to his clan, he was enslaved and forced to become a gladiator in Zygerrian arenas, earning the moniker the "Prince's Sword" due to his undefeated record. In his absence, Vera assumed leadership of Clan Awaud, guiding them through the challenges of the Galactic Civil War. 

===Role in the Defense of Xorrn===
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] allies to defend the planet [[Xorrn/Legends|Xorrn]] from an impending Imperial assault. Recognizing the strategic advantage of Mandalorian warriors, Rebel operatives approached Vera for assistance. Despite her initial reservations and the challenges facing her own clan, Vera agreed to dispatch warriors to aid in [[Battle of Xorrn/Legends|Xorrn's defense]], demonstrating her strategic acumen and commitment to broader galactic concerns.

==Personality and traits==
Vera was renowned for her unwavering integrity and intolerance for deception. She valued honesty and straightforwardness, making her a formidable negotiator who was resistant to flattery and impervious to threats. Her leadership was marked by a commitment to traditional Mandalorian values, emphasizing honor, loyalty, and martial excellence.
